newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU agrees to send mission to Albania.
newsitem.headline: EU agrees to send mission to Albania.

text.p: The European Union agreed on Saturday to send a mission to Albania immediately to offer help in reconstruction and to consider providing a small police force to the shattered country, Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said.
"The European Union will send immediately a mission to Tirana," Dini told reporters.
Dini said the EU wanted Albania to know it wished to make a "strong contribution" to the reconstruction of the country.
He said the police force would be sent if the EU received a mandate from the United Nations.
He emphasised that the police force was not the same as military intervention, over which EU ministers meeting in the Dutch town of Apeldoorn had disagreed.

Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said earlier that the ministers had been sharply divided over whether to support military intervention, with Britain, Germany and Sweden being vehemently against the idea.
